'''Jungle Felucians''' were a primitive [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of [[amphibian]]s native to the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Felucia]]. Members of the species were [[force-sensitive|tuned]] to the ever-changing presence of [[the Force]] on their [[homeworld]]. Jungle Felucians largely kept to themselves, but when members of the [[Gossam]] species arrived on the world they drove the Jungle Felucians into hiding deep within the planet's wild [[forest]]s.<ref name="BMF" /> The Jungle Felucians were one of two species native to Felucia with the other being the more peaceful [[Felucian]]s.<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-lost-one-episode-guide|text="The Lost One" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Jungle Felucians were mentioned in the [[2015]] magazine [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 21|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 21]].<ref name="BMF" /> The [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|species]] was originally developed for the [[2008]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] and surrounding [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|multimedia project]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> They were mentioned prior to the release of the game in [[October]] of [[2007]] in an article that was part of a series titled [[The Force Unleashed (Star Wars Miniatures)|''The Force Unleashed Preview'']], published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on their website to promote the upcoming [[The Force Unleashed (Star Wars Miniatures)|''The Force Unleashed''-themed]] ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' line.<ref name="TFU preview">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/FUpreview2|text=''The Force Unleashed'' Preview 2}}</ref> In an earlier version of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|Season Six]] episode "[[The Lost One]]", parts of the [[Jedi]]'s [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)|investigation]] of the disappearance of [[Sifo-Dyas]] would have originally taken place on Felucia and shown violent Jungle Felucians, with concept art being created for their appearance.<ref name="Ep Guide" />
